what: What each platform runtime does with the change-set entry of Todos.visible after one title change, at 1,000 / 10,000 / 100,000 rows (750 / 7,500 / 75,000 visible): before ADR-039 the full value (decode the whole list with the generated Todo codec), after it one keyed-patch op (decodePatch + applyPatch). Median per apply, best of three. Throwaway probes against each runtime's own reader, codecs and applyPatch (as ADR-039's were), not committed; the rows are what they printed.

platforms.note: applyPatch returns a new array (React keeps unchanged rows' identity): the one-op cost at 100,000 rows is that copy, paid once per drain (ADR-031)
applyPatch copies the list into a new one
applyPatch(_:to:) is inout: in place unless another reference (a SwiftUI view's copy) holds the array, then copy-on-write
